blocks.text: THE HANDS OF THE DOOMSDAY CLOCK— ‘‘Bulletin of Atomic Scientists — In January 1980, the minute hand was at 7 minutes to midnight, it was moved to 4 minutes to midnight in January 1982; in December 1983, it was moved to 3 minutes to midnight; in the summer of 1986, it was moved to 1 minute to midnight; evidently because of the bombing of the Mediterranean (Libya) near the Mid-East area!’ — ‘‘They feel that someday an incident like this could spark the last world war! — The clock may swing back a little and forward, but its inevitable, world holocaust is just around the comer!’’ — ‘‘God’s clock is ticking too, and the times of the Gentiles is at hand (midnight)!’’ — Ps. 33:8-9, ‘‘Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him! For he spake and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast!’? — ‘‘We are in a transition period in restoration, gathering the harvest and preparing for translation!’’ — “‘The later 80’s and early 90’s will be a decade of extreme shock and change! — Some of the events that I have seen approaching could well have been called unbelievable a few years back or belong to the world of fantasy, but these events are definitely timed and are advancing towards us in the years ahead! — Some of the events involve science, politics, weather patterns, changes in the earth itself, the economy, world religions, intemational leaders, the Mid-East, Europe, immorality, social uprisings, changes and etc. . . . And ever so many other things that we will touch upon later!’’

THINGS TO COME— “‘In the following paragraphs we will also write 10 different subjects to watch leading to Armageddon!’’ — ‘‘First Israel is God’s time clock and will be constantly in the spotlight ending age! — Middle East events are developing to bring forth the anti-christ on the world scene and finally controlling all energy supplies! — Watch the leaders meeting with Israel and news concerning the Jewish Temple!”’

PROPHECY— ‘‘Look for developments concerning Russia and her sinister movements, for later the Bear will offer peaceful overtures, but this is only to tighten the grip concerning neighbors that surround Israel! — In the final end Russia wants the Mid-East spoils of wealth!”’ — ‘‘As the age closes out a great and horrifying famine will effect the north and the east nations. The loss of lives and skeletons everywhere! — The rider of death spears no mercy, later the whole world will suffer shortages!’’ — ‘‘Behold the eyes of the Lord is upon the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry. . . . The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them to the earth!’’ — ‘‘Those who make war shall manufacture their own doom for their cry shall be great upon the earth! — The day is almost gone, night cometh! . . . Come My children gather thee under My wings, for thou shall be like unto the 91st Psalm and thy flight is near!’’ PROPHECY MARCHES ON — ‘‘Look for events concerning the Common Market (Western Europe)! — Although the United States will disagree off and on with them in finality will be in a world trade trap! . . . More nations are added and this will become World Commercial Babylon controlled by the anti-christ system! . . . Also watch a world political and government church called Mystery Babylon! (Rev. 17) — This electronic mistress will unite all false religions, bringing great persecution upon.the earth! — Even for a time riding and controlling the deadly beast of terror until it turns upon her!’’ (Rev. 17:16) CONTINUING — “‘In the future we see a new economy appearing, a new political system and a new social and religious order! . . . This appears out of perplexity, economic and social woes!’’ — ‘‘According to the Scriptures inflation returns more than ever before! — It also predicts that our type of currency today will be done away with finally! — As we can see all nations are caught up in the printing paper mania now! — In fact later, inflation becomes so terrible that the people of the earth will work a whole day just to buy a loaf of bread!’’ (Rev. 6:6) . . . And we also know that evidently before some of this that Commercial Babylon brings great prosperity! (Rev. 18) — It seems craft prospers under the magic touch of the dictator! (Dan. 8:25) — The things for us to watch in the coming days ahead, read below. PROPHECY CONTINUING — ‘‘It is said now the coming thing is the debit cards! — As you remember 1979-80 I predicted the very way that people are doing business now, by electronic cards and credit! . . . And other vast changes are ahead! — Super computers will bring about many new things, finally master-minding the world economy! — This in turn leads to Rev. 13:15-18!’’ — ‘‘The invention of artificial intelligence in a super computer will profoundly alter our entire social structure and create new economics in a new historical order! — If you have noticed in the grocery stores the numbers and code marks are actually omens of things to appear later! — That is to say finally computer, laser or electronic code marks will be given! . . . And we know this as the mark of the beast!’’ — ‘‘The increase of knowedge and inventions will pick up the momentum!’

RUN PROPHECY RUN— ‘‘Just before the mark of the beast, events will happen suddenly and swiftly concerning the harvest work, and the Lord’s children will be translated!’’ — ““We are to expect a surge of the miraculous and a powerful anointing to appear just before His coming! — A spiritual uniting in one powerful body as never seen before! . . . Although this body is made up of many people the Lord’s spirit will talk to each individual as never before; in fact they will be covered with the ‘light rays’ of heaven! — We are in preparation of this now, we can feel the fresh dew we are actually beginning in the thicker glory presence of the Almighty! — Watch and pray!’’ RELIGIOUS SIGNS — “‘Everywhere we see apostasy, sorcery, withcraft phenomena, false cults and just plain wizardry and the occult! — Ever so many things are occuring, here is one for an example: . . . Just this past year, scores of people, many of them middle-aged women, have left their homes around the country and in Canada and moved to the Pacific Northwest to live near a 40-year-old woman, a beautiful blonde! — J. Z. Knight, who says she is the embodiment of a 35,000-year-old man!’’ — ‘‘She says this man appeared to her, but we know it was a demon impersonating a man! . . . C.B.S. News did a story concerning her, then she was on A.B.C.’s 20-20 program! — And they filmed her in one of her actual speaking engagements! It showed her yielding to this spirit force going under a change, her face and eyes take on a more direct, stern look; and her voice speaks differently! — The voice says it came from sunken Atlantis, and rambles on telling about various subjects! — Making the audience think that it is a god of some sort, and then suddenly without any reason at all the voice turned and said that it was ‘a bastard’ and then rambling on about self peace, and said each one was a god and could heal and save themselves, etc.!’’ — ‘‘But we know only the Lord Jesus can do this for us! . . . And then she went into the audience and kissed the women and men tenderly! — We might say that much of the things she did was a fine acting job, some movie stars could not have done better! . . . In fact many stars are going to see her and her performances personally! — To mention a few, Shirley MacLane, Linda Evans of the T.V. drama, Dynasty, etc.’’ — ‘‘The news said the woman is getting quite wealthy and they thought it was a cosmic con game! — Evidently it is true, something did appear to the woman, but with the wrong influences! Because it is definitely not in line with the Word at all!”’ — ‘Paul spoke of different situations akin to this! (I Tim. 4:1 — IT Tim. 4:3-4) — We are in the age of prophecy where people are no longer enduring sound doctrine! — But because of the fear of the future they are running in every direction and some are calling upon evil guides and ghosts to lead them! — And as the Scriptures say they will be turned into fables!’’ — “‘Truly it is wonderful to know the Lord Jesus and His Word is the true guide!’’

PROPHETIC TIME— ‘‘This is in line with the Scriptures so I have decided to print it here! They found a true writing of one of the companions of Paul. . . . The rediscovered text reads, ‘‘the Lord will make an end of everything in six thousand years, and then will establish the 1,000-year Millennial Kingdom as a time of special sancitity!’ — Another ancient writer was Irenanus, who wrote not long after the apostle John, and has been considered as one of ‘the stars’ in the Lord’s hand! (Rev. 1:16, 20) — Anyway we quote: ‘For in so many days as this world was made, in so many thousand years shall it be concluded . . . and God brought to a conclusion upon the sixth day the works He had made! This is an account of the things formerly created, as also it is a prophecy of what is to come . . . in six days created things completed; it is evident, therefore, that they will come to an end at the sixth thousand year (entering millennium)!’’ — ‘‘Now we must remember the words of Jesus, there will be a shortening of time and the translation! — If the above be correct, and it sounds in agreément with the Scriptures, then we are to look for the Lord at any time or in the very near future!’’ — ‘‘Be ye also ready!’’ — ‘‘From the place of His habitation He beholdeth all the sons of men, and the people whom He hath chosen for His own inheritance!’’ — ‘‘Time is running out, and God is gathering the true believer! — Amen!’’
